what_happened: Recorded grader ranked the lexical arm, which returned possible_match on 45 of 45 runs and never committed, above baseline. Regraded from the case definitions the visible-split ranking reverses (Spearman 0.485).
cause: Recorded grader gives credit for abstaining; why it was built that way has not been traced
prevention: agentbench flags a ranking inversion between the recorded and the harness grader; the chat-archaeologist grader itself is unchanged

what_happened: Four visible and six holdout cases per arm; paired tests were not run because only 2 cases were non-tied.
cause: Small case bank in the source study
prevention: agentbench labels such estimates descriptive, not inferential; it does not stop a run

what_happened: Identical cases scored differently on every repeat (all 4 cases unstable, mean within-case SD 0.577).
cause: Not diagnosed
prevention: None yet

what_happened: One case in total, 12 runs with 3 errored, so baseline and challenger cannot be compared.
cause: Only one case was registered
prevention: agentbench marks the comparison not comparable; it does not stop a run

what_happened: exactComplete is not comparable across the three result records.

cause: Banks were calibrated against the extremes (baseline and reference), not the quality band the candidates occupied
prevention: Scar-ledger entry; resolution screen adopted as a warning, not a block; pool-resolution check (PR #19) is not wired into any run path

what_happened: 7 of 13 (Task 4) and 10 of 14 (Task 5) multi-member descriptor groups held candidates that behave differently; P(same behaviour given same descriptor) = 0.60 and 0.32.
cause: Descriptor and behaviour partitions cross-cut rather than nest
prevention: Scar-ledger entry (descriptor not an equivalence class)

what_happened: Qualification score vs sealed score: Spearman +0.050 (Task 4) and -0.029 (Task 5).
cause: 38 of 48 and 45 of 48 candidates scored a perfect diagnostic, so the proxy had almost nothing to rank
prevention: None yet

what_happened: The selector study was stopped because the existing banks lack the resolution to show any difference.
cause: Same banks as the successor study
prevention: Eight reopening conditions written down; screen is a warning

what_happened: One hand-built task cannot support a claim about a word; a memorised convention would also suppress run-to-run scatter.
cause: Single-task design
prevention: Redesigned around 30 benchmark tasks; agentbench rejects designs under 5 cases as descriptive
caught_by: Protocol review and harness coverage rule

what_happened: Reviewers found the interval attached to the wrong contrast (no genuine falsified outcome possible), one arm orthogonal to the fuzzer that reads the outcome, and no smallest effect of interest.
cause: All four faults follow from swapping a hand-built task for 30 benchmark tasks with a generic fuzzer
prevention: Two-arm redesign with a single primary contrast and a smallest effect of interest
caught_by: Same-author review, then two independent reviewers

what_happened: Fuzz probes were seeded with Python hash(), which differs per process, so probe sets would not repeat between runs.
cause: Non-deterministic seeding in the registration
prevention: Seed replaced with a sha256-based integer in v2 and the probe set archived; delta review 2 found zero main findings remaining

what_happened: The thin Bitcoin brief already produced the thick spec's fonts and colours (5 of 5 or 4 of 5 runs), so the manipulation had almost nothing to move.
cause: Business chosen for the test matched the spec by default
prevention: Preflight manipulation checks before the batch (v2 protocol)

what_happened: A 16k output cap truncated 10 of 15 thick-brief pages (about 21k tokens each); those cells were re-run.
cause: Cap set below the page length
prevention: Cap sized from the preflight pages; v2 had 0 truncations in 30 pages

what_happened: Ten blocking defects, including identical facet vectors across two confusable clusters, so per-mode counts would depend on the rater.
cause: Facets did not separate the clusters
prevention: Disambiguator field added per cluster (v2.4); agreement not yet measurable

what_happened: Kappa 0.486 from 17 of 18 windows both coded NONE; one item swings kappa between 0.308 and 1.0, so the pilot cannot measure agreement.
cause: Uniform sampling of real sessions does not yield codable failures at a useful rate
prevention: None yet; needs a sample enriched for real failures

what_happened: Two discordant queries, p = 0.50: the description comparison was unresolved.
cause: Twenty queries
prevention: Expanded to 50 queries

what_happened: 45 of 48 vs 42 of 48 correct: three fixed and none broken, within noise at this n.
cause: Fifty queries with few discordant pairs

what_happened: 10 of 300 judge calls returned empty (stop reason max_tokens); queries 29 and 30 lost too many calls in one arm and were dropped, leaving n = 48.

prevention: None recorded

what_happened: Round 3 reported a blocking defect that was a false positive: the auditor ran in a depth-capped frame and treated its own errors as evidence about the platform.
cause: Auditor could not see its own frame limits
